label: App tour
replayHint: See what the app can do from the start

welcome.title: Training, food and habits in one place.
welcome.body: Five tabs, one logbook. Let's take a minute to see what you can do.

workouts.title: Plan it, get guided, get stronger.
workouts.body: Plan your weekdays. In a session, last time's weights and the rest timer are right there; the AI coach suggests programs.

track.title: Your whole day in one logbook.
track.body: Weight and measurements, food search or AI estimates, sleep and water, habits and to-dos. Your photos are end-to-end encrypted.

progress.title: Every entry scores, every day builds a streak.
progress.body: Home shows your day and your week. Daily caps keep points fair, and 32 badges are waiting.

social.title: Together if you like, solo if you don't.
social.body: Community is optional and off by default. Turn it on for the feed, groups and the ranking.

privacy.title: Your data belongs to you.
privacy.body: Nobody else can see your entries. In Settings you can export your data, delete your account and manage consents.

install.title: Add it to your iPhone Home Screen.
install.body: In Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. That turns on reminders and offline use.

mock.photosEncrypted: Progress photos are encrypted on your device
